note: What a server sends to set one slot of a unit's inventory. The header names the unit. A client empties the slot, then fills it where count is above zero, and refreshes the shop where the unit is its own champion.

fields.name: item
fields.note: The item. Unread where count is zero.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which slot, 0 to 39. A client ignores the message from 40 up.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many. Zero leaves the slot empty.
